description: Ticket T-3. Add unit tests for the Direct frame codec in src/main/direct-frame.ts: FrameReader, encodeFrame, transferBody, and readTransferBody. The product code does not change.
steps: Read global-sct/src/main/direct-frame.ts and global-sct/tests/envelope.test.ts (for the test style).
Create global-sct/tests/direct-frame.test.ts with one test for each line in tests.must_add.
From global-sct/ run each command in verification.
Commit the one new file with one commit.
acceptance_criteria: tests/direct-frame.test.ts exists and each line of tests.must_add has a test
Each test calls the real functions of src/main/direct-frame.ts with real Buffers
No test allocates more than 64 KiB
bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run lint, and bun run test pass, and `bun test direct-frame.test.ts` passes

must_add: A frame that arrives in split chunks (the 4-byte length header split, then the body split) gives no frame until the last byte, then one frame with the correct kind and body
Two frames in one chunk give two frames in order, and a later chunk gives the next frame
A frame with length 0 is rejected with 'The Direct frame is too large.'
A length header of 1 + 4 + transferLimit + wrappedKeyLimit + 1 is rejected when only the 4 header bytes have arrived, and the same header minus 1 is not rejected
encodeFrame and transferBody round-trip through FrameReader and readTransferBody
readTransferBody rejects a body with payload length 0, a body with no wrapped key, and a body shorter than 5 bytes
readTransferBody rejects surplus bytes: a wrapped key of 4,097 bytes is rejected with 'The Direct wrapped key is invalid.', and a wrapped key of 4,096 bytes is accepted
